tasks.title: Define the launch checklist
tasks.description: List the product, documentation, support, and announcement checks that must be complete before launch.

tasks.title: Review onboarding copy
tasks.description: Check the first-run instructions for clarity and make sure every action matches the current interface.

tasks.title: Fix mobile navigation spacing
tasks.description: The navigation wraps at narrow widths. Confirm the intended breakpoint before changing the layout.

tasks.title: Prepare customer import sample
tasks.description: Create a small anonymized file that demonstrates the supported import fields and validation errors.

tasks.title: Publish API error reference
tasks.description: Document the public error codes with a cause, a recovery action, and one minimal request example for each.

tasks.title: Confirm analytics events
tasks.description: Verify that sign-up, workspace creation, and first successful edit are recorded once with the expected properties.

tasks.title: Prepare the customer newsletter
tasks.description: Draft the monthly product update with three highlights and a clear link to the release notes.

tasks.title: Test the sign-up flow
tasks.description: Check account creation on desktop and mobile, including validation messages and the welcome email.

tasks.title: Approve launch visuals
tasks.description: Review the homepage illustrations and campaign images, then export the approved assets.

tasks.title: Map legacy customer fields
tasks.description: Match each legacy field to the new customer schema and document any required transformations.

tasks.title: Review duplicate customer records
tasks.description: Identify duplicate email addresses and agree on a merge rule before running the import.

tasks.title: Back up the staging dataset
tasks.description: Create a staging backup and confirm that a small sample can be restored successfully.

tasks.title: Write the migration handover guide
tasks.description: Explain the import steps, validation checks, rollback procedure, and owners for the support team.

tasks.title: Add API pagination examples
tasks.description: Show how to request the next page and handle an empty result using a short runnable example.

tasks.title: Triage customer support feedback
tasks.description: Group recent support questions by theme and select the three documentation improvements with the greatest impact.

tasks.title: Update the new-hire setup checklist
tasks.description: Refresh the workstation setup steps and check that every link works for a new team member.

tasks.title: Check dashboard event coverage
tasks.description: Compare the event list with the launch checklist and record the result of each verification.

tasks.title: Schedule the launch rehearsal
tasks.description: Arrange a walkthrough with engineering, marketing, and support; assign an owner to each launch step.
